title: Chusky has been upgraded
bullets: Expanded bounded E2B runs with independent limits, declared postconditions, verified completion checks, safe challenge handoff, fresh-observation recovery, and no-progress blocking.

Owners can start idempotent multi-day lead campaigns that research, deduplicate, qualify, and track source-linked candidates in private durable state, with honest shortfall reporting and verifiable closeout.

Discovery uses supplied seeds and read-only sources; Treg enrichment uses an atomic campaign spend allowance. Campaigns never contact prospects or write CRM. Pulse records checks, candidates, approvals, delivery, no provider payloads.
